description:
Where have we not met?"

Before getting to know each other, Chin and Yeha had already met several times.  
Can the two complete their relationship by putting together a puzzle of coincidence?  
A campus romance that begins with the third point of contact between the two who seemed to be at odds for the rest of their lives.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/home/55521493), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000052773), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8474681), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/accidental_junction), Manhwa Kyung, [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/8326)
